items.prompt: A record has a valid new ID, symbol, side, price and timestamp. Which quantity field passes the declared lexical rule?

options.why: Leading zero is forbidden by [1-9][0-9]* even though int("01") can produce 1.
The sign is forbidden by the ASCII quantity grammar even though int("+1") can produce 1.
Quantity must be positive; zero is outside this quantity contract.
It starts with 1 through 9, contains no sign or leading zero, and is within the upper bound.
